      "name": "mining",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled Mining; updates interfaces::Mining, block template management, and mining IPC block submission.",

      "score": 0.55,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds atomic block preference on submission for external miners using IPC, eliminating round-trips and race conditions against competing equal-work chain tips. Downstream miners currently must make a separate preciousblock RPC call and risk racing concurrent chain activations."
    },

      "name": "rpc",

      "rationale": "The minor edit to src/rpc/blockchain.cpp only adapts the preciousblock RPC caller to the modified PreciousBlock signature."
    },

      "name": "tests",

    },

      "name": "validation",
